    - Auditor IAM role (temporary)
    - `s3:GetObject` only
    - No write/delete permissions
  - Access logs enabled in S3 bucket for audit trail.

- **Prometheus Dashboard Access**:  
  - Link provided: `https://monitoring.prod.example.com/alerts?alert=API_Response_Time_Exceeds_89ms`
